description: This file defines the PlatformCapsData class, which provides platform capabilities information and RPC mechanisms for device and display services within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes methods for retrieving device info, supported features, and managing JSON RPC communication.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Main class providing device capability information and RPC communication functionalities.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc
classes.description: Nested class managing JSON RPC client connections and invocation.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Handles individual JSON RPC direct link communication with device services.

methods.name: AddDashExclusionList
methods.description: Adds dash exclusion list to the provided hash.

methods.name: CanMixPCMWithSurround
methods.description: Determines if PCM can be mixed with surround sound.

methods.name: GetFirmwareUpdateDisabled
methods.description: Checks if firmware updates are disabled.

methods.name: DeviceCapsFeatures
methods.description: Returns device capabilities features as a map.

methods.name: XCALSessionTokenAvailable
methods.description: Checks if XCAL session token is available.
